description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy, in percentage values, for different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the model configurations, labeled “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition,” with the bars arranged in this order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks at 2.5-unit intervals. There are two sets of bars for each configuration: a darker shade and a lighter shade. For the “Ours” configuration, the darker bar reaches approximately 86.82% and the lighter bar reaches approximately 90.57%. For “w/o comments”, the darker bar reaches approximately 80.10% and the lighter bar reaches approximately 85.85%. For “w/o select”, the darker bar reaches approximately 87.34% and the lighter bar reaches approximately 83.02%. For “w/o emotion”, the darker bar reaches approximately 87.17% and the lighter bar reaches approximately 84.91%. Finally, for “w/o cognition”, the darker bar reaches approximately 89.62% and the lighter bar reaches approximately 87.74%. The darker bars are consistently positioned in front of the lighter bars, and a vertical dashed line separates the first two configurations from the remaining three.
